subject: Pricing & context-length follow-up: profiling data & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — context length profiling / pricing

Thanks for the call today, Samir — great to hear how Acme is planning to use the model for real-time support and long-form case summarization. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on: 

- What we heard: production use will be a mix of short prompts (chat support) and long documents (case transcripts). Estimated monthly active users: ~25k; expected average sessions/day ~8k.
- Action items for Acme: upload the sample prompt/completion traces (we discussed the token export) and share a simple distribution of prompt vs. completion sizes. A sample CSV or the template I attached is fine.
- Redwood action items: run a context-length pricing sensitivity using ACME sample traces; share 8k/32k/128k profiling + unit cost scenarios and a target $/1M tokens plan.

A few clarifying Qs to help our pricing model:
1) For the long-form flows, what's the typical output length you expect — are completions usually 1–2k tokens or 4–8k tokens?
2) Any regulatory constraints that would force Private deployment (we discussed VPC/KMS) or will Hosted API be acceptable during evaluation?

I've attached the token_profile template (acme_token_profile.xlsx) — fill columns for avg_prompt_tokens, avg_completion_tokens, percent_8k_need, percent_32k_need, percent_128k_need. If you can get that back by EOD Wed PST, we can push a first-pass pricing by Thursday.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: acme_token_profile.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <s.patel@acme-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Kumar <r.kumar@acme-ai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — context length profiling / pricing

Thanks Marissa — solid recap. Confirming a few datapoints from our side: 

- Typical chat support prompts: avg_prompt_tokens ~ 45–75; avg_completion_tokens ~ 120–200. These are for the live agent-assist flows.
- Long-form summarization (daily transcripts): avg_prompt_tokens ~ 1,200 (prompt includes concatenated context + system instructions), avg_completion_tokens ~ 2,800 on average (we do some trimming).
- Distribution estimates: ~70% sessions are short chat (fits easily in 8k), ~25% are medium long (benefit from 32k), ~5% need 128k (multi-doc aggregation + legal review).
- Monthly token estimate (best-effort): 2.4B prompt tokens / month, 4.8B completion tokens / month (total ~7.2B tokens/month). This is from our current staging logs scaled to expected traffic.

On deployment: hosted API OK for POC; enterprise will require VPC/KMS for production. Procurement will loop in later for contract/PO.

I’ll get you the completed template by tomorrow EOD.

Samir
Head of AI Products | Acme AI
s.patel@acme-ai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — context length profiling / pricing

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the numbers — very helpful. A couple quick notes on how we’ll approach pricing and unit economics: 

- Unit economics: we’ll present scenarios in $ per 1M tokens (combined prompt+completion) and also show split prompt/completion pricing since some customers prefer that visibility.
- Baseline target: for POC customers we often aim to show a target blended cost in the ~$700–$1,200 per 1M tokens band depending on model family and quantization.
- For your mix (70% short, 25% 32k, 5% 128k) we’ll produce three scenarios: Hosted (best-effort throughput), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), and Private (enterprise, with a platform fee).
- Cost levers we’ll model: batching, KV/prefix caching impact (for repeat prompts), and model quantization (fp16 vs int8). David will run perf profiles to give latency/SLO estimates at your projected peak TPS.

Next steps: 
1) Once we receive your completed token_profile, David will run the context-length profiling and provide perf + cost curves (expected tokens processed, per-1M assumptions).
2) We’ll return a redlined pricing spreadsheet (redwood_pricing_calc_v3.xlsx) with recommended target $/1M tokens for each scenario and sensitivity to latency/throughput.
3) If procurement needs a PO/contract template, I’ll loop legal after we align on target pricing.

Samir — would you be able to flag any hard budget ceilings from procurement now (ballpark numbers) so we can prioritize model choices? If procurement is comfortable in the ~$800–$1,200 /1M tokens range we’ll prioritize medium-latency, lower-cost variants.

Thanks — I’ll kick off David’s profiling run after we get your sheet.

Best,
Marissa

From: procurement@acme-ai.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <s.patel@acme-ai.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & context-length follow-up: profiling data & next steps

Hi Marissa — procurement here. High level budget guidance:

- For the initial enterprise rollout (year 1), we’re targeting a platform + inference spend of ~$900k–$1.1M annually. Given Samir’s traffic estimates, that maps to a blended target of roughly $1,000 per 1M tokens (prompt+completion combined) before discounts.
- Key procurement asks: consolidated billing, usage caps, and data residency controls. We will require an SLA and SOC2 evidence for production.

Please send the pricing template and any contract baselines you normally use for Dedicated/Private deals.

Regards,
Acme Procurement Team
procurement@acme-ai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@acme-ai.com>; procurement@acme-ai.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & context-length follow-up: profiling data & next steps

Thanks — that budget guidance is great and aligns with what we typically see. Quick summary / immediate next steps: 

- Acme to send completed token_profile (attached template) by EOD today — Samir confirmed timing.
- David will run context-length profiling (8k/32k/128k) and produce latency and cost curves by EOD Thurs 12/3.
- I’ll send the redwood_pricing_calc_v3.xlsx with three scenarios (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and a recommended target blended price aiming at ~$1,000 /1M tokens, plus sensitivity to caching and batching.
- Procurement: I’ll also attach our standard Dedicated/Private contract baseline and SOC2 evidence link in the next email for your review.

If there’s nothing else, we’ll reconvene after the profiling run — I’ll schedule a 30-min review for Friday to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_pricing_calc_v3.xlsx
